bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d"
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "fix/debugai-scout-diagnosis-handoff-20261016"
test "$(git remote get-url origin)" = "https://github.com/seigo-gace/debug-ai.git"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
docker exec -i debug-ai-debug-ai-1 node - <<'NODE'
const fs=require("node:fs"),p=require("node:path"),d="/app/runtime/durable/durable/run-state-v2";const counts={};
for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>/^run_[A-Za-z0-9_]+[.]json$/.test(x))){const s=require("/app/orchestrator/durable-primitives.js").decodeEnvelope(fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,f)),{expectedSchema:"run-state/v2"});if(s.schema!=="run-state/v2"||s.run_id+".json"!==f)throw Error("STATE_MISMATCH");counts[s.job_status]=(counts[s.job_status]||0)+1;if(!["DONE","BLOCKED","FAILED","CANCELLED","PAUSED"].includes(s.job_status))throw Error("ACTIVE_RUN:"+s.run_id);}
console.log("DURABLE_STATE_COUNTS="+JSON.stringify(counts));
NODE
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/debugai-scout-diagnosis-handoff-20261016
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d" "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,"/home/admin1/server-core/scripts")
from servercore_service_deploy_admission import inspect_host,REGISTRY
expected=sorted(["docs/CURRENT_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION.md","scripts/real-debug-corpus.json","scripts/real-debug-suite.cjs","server/control/real-debug-benchmark.js","server/tests/real-debug-benchmark.test.cjs","server/tests/real-debug-suite.test.cjs","server/workflow-observed.js"])
actual=sorted(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","--no-renames","e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d","0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"],text=True).splitlines())
if actual!=expected:raise SystemExit("EXACT_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
registry=json.loads(REGISTRY.read_text())
for service in ("debug-ai","sandbox-runner"):
 a=inspect_host(registry,"seigo-gace/debug-ai","e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d",service)
 if hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e:"+a["compose_file"]])).hexdigest()!=a["compose_digest"]:raise SystemExit("COMPOSE_DIGEST_MISMATCH")
print("SCOPE_PASS")
PY
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null merge --ff-only "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
for service in debug-ai sandbox-runner; do
 python3 -B /home/admin1/server-core/scripts/servercore_registered_service_deploy.py --repository seigo-gace/debug-ai --target-sha "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e" --service "$service"
done
printf 'EXACT_SOURCE_PREPARED=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
